en:or.definition: veya, ya da · aksi takdirde, yoksa · either · ifadeyi oluşturan iki kısımdan en az birinin değerinin bir (1) olması durumunda bir (1) sonucunu üreten, aksi takdirde sıfır (0) sonucunu üreten mantıksal işlem.
en:or.enDefinition: Connects at least two alternative words, phrases, clauses, sentences, etc., each of which could make a passage true. · An operator denoting the disjunction of two propositions or truth values. There are two forms: the inclusive or and the exclusive or. · Counts the elements before and after as two possibilities. · Otherwise (a consequence of the condition that the previous is false).

en:been.deDefinition: sein, existieren · sich in einer bestimmten, betonten Weise verhalten, sein (existieren) · sein · sein

en:our.definition: bizim · Kullanım ve çekim bağlama göre değişir.
en:our.enDefinition: Belonging to us, excluding the person(s) being addressed (exclusive our). · Belonging to us, including the person(s) being addressed (inclusive our). · Of, from, or belonging to any entity that the speaker is a part of or identifies with, such as place of employment or education, nation, region, language, etc. · Belonging to people in general.
en:our.deDefinition: unser · Die Form hängt vom Satzkontext ab.

en:gonna.enDefinition: A modal used to express a future action that is being planned or prepared for in the present.

en:tell.enDefinition: To determine the number, amount, or value of [something]. · To notice, discern. (Roughly, "can tell" means "know" but with a sense of direct perception.) · To pick up on a difference. (See tell apart for more.) · To narrate, to recount.

en:really.definition: öyle mi? · gerçekten mi? · harbiden mi?
en:really.enDefinition: indicating surprise at, or requesting confirmation of, some new information
en:really.pairedSense: indicating surprise at, or requesting confirmation of, some new information

en:man.deDefinition: Mann · Herr · Maa · mo · må · môô

en:some.enDefinition: A nonzero, unspecified proportion of (a bounded set of countable things): at least two. · A nonzero, unspecified quantity or number of (an unbounded set of countable things). · An unspecified amount of (something uncountable). · A certain, an unspecified or unknown.
en:some.deDefinition: unspezifizierte Anzahl von Objekten oder Personen

en:say.enDefinition: To pronounce. · To recite. · To tell, either verbally or in writing. · To indicate in a written form.

en:hey.enDefinition: An exclamation to get attention. · A protest or reprimand. · An expression of surprise. · An informal greeting, similar to hi.

en:could.enDefinition: Used as a past subjunctive (contrary to fact). · Used to politely ask for permission to do something. · Used to politely ask for someone else to do something. · Used to show the possibility that something might happen.

en:need.enDefinition: A requirement for something; something needed. · A desire or craving for the satisfaction of a requirement perceived as essential or primal. · Lack of means of subsistence; poverty; indigence; destitution.

en:something.enDefinition: An uncertain or unspecified thing; one thing. · A quality to a moderate degree. · A talent or quality that is difficult to specify. · Somebody who or something that is superlative or notable in some way.
en:something.deDefinition: etwas; ein Ding, das unbestimmt oder unbekannt ist

en:has.enDefinition: To possess, own. · To hold, as something at someone's disposal. · To include as a part, ingredient, or feature. · Used to state the existence or presence of someone in a specified relationship with the subject.
en:has.deDefinition: haben; besitzen; zur Verfügung haben · erfahren, erleben · (eine Sprache, ein Fach) kennen, können · (jemanden) betrugen
